newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC SIGN VILLA'S JOHNSON FOR $3.9 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC SIGN VILLA'S JOHNSON FOR $3.9 MILLION.

text.p: Scottish giants Celtic signed striker Tommy Johnson from English premier league side Aston Villa on Friday for 2.4 million pounds ($3.9 million).
Johnson, 26, joins Celtic on a 4 1/2 year contract after rejecting a move to Villa's Midlands rivals Derby County earlier this month.

"I thought Aston Villa were a big club, but I realise Celtic are another step forward when I see this magnificent stadium and know that I will be playing for over 40,000 supporters at every home match," Johnson said.
"Celtic are an extremely ambitious club with a great history."
